name: The Sudd (Ramsar wetland)
story: The Sudd is a vast swamp in South Sudan formed by the White Nile's Bahr al-Jabal section. Designated as a Ramsar Wetland in 2006, it covers an area of 57,000 square kilometres and features meandering channels, lagoons, and floating papyrus fields.
matters: The Sudd is one of the world's largest wetlands and the largest freshwater wetland in the Nile Basin, storing floodwaters and trapping sediments from the Bahr al-Jabal.
